text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... alright.
I guess I'll head back soon—

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...?
Oh, a LANE message from Ruby.)

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... a cold?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... yeah, you took medicine already, that's good.
Right, then make sure to get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yeah... I see,
so I don't catch it, right. Okay,
I'll ask the dorm rep if I can stay in her room.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you need anything, let me know...
Ah, you're fine? I see, yeah, understood.
...Well then, see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Ruby is amazing.
Even when she's unwell, she's so composed.
It doesn't seem like she needs my help at all...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Like, she doesn't want
any drinks or food at ALL?!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she said care packages weren't necessary...
She told me over the phone that she already gathered
everything she needed by herself, though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is that so~?
Well then, this right here—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't a care package, it's a present!
I'll just hang it on her doorknob for now☆

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aight, I'm off~~~~!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(......
Not a care package, but a present.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Miracle. Listen, keep this in mind.
'For the sake of others' is important too. But—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's okay for you to cherish your own
desire of wanting to try things out, you know.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...A present, huh.
(Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Who is it?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... sorry, did I wake you?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, I had only just awakened a moment ago.
...Miracle-san, did you need something from me?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... yeah.
I came to leave a present.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's not... something necessary
for you, though.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I really love banana mousse.
Back then when I had fevers,
this was the only thing that tasted good.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So... yeah.
I wanted to give some to you too, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, that's all.
Get plenty of rest, okay? ...See you.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... haah...

At night, even though curfew was approaching,
I spotted KS Miracle running.
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you be heading back soon?
Shouldn't you be heading back soon?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes, that's true, it's about time.
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I thought I was keeping
an eye on the time myself, but...

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe it's because I did something I'm not used to.
It made me feel strangely restless.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... fufu, this is no good.
...My heart is still racing.

Though she said that, her expression
looked rather fulfilled.
